# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**My top pick is the JBL Charge 6.** What Hi-Fi named it best overall, and BestProducts did too. It's rated IP68 (dust-tight and submersible), lasts about 20 hours (28 with Playtime Boost), and can charge your phone. Prices in the results run from about $130 at Walmart to $150 at Amazon. [What Hi-Fi review and buy links](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)

## Other good options

- **Loudest and most pool-proof: JBL Boombox 4.** RTINGS ranks it the best waterproof speaker it has tested. It floats, handles long immersion, and runs over 40 hours. It's big, and the sound is narrow, so it's best aimed at the crowd. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- **Best 360° sound: Ultimate Ears Epicboom.** Tom's Guide picked it as best overall, and RTINGS as best mid-range. It's IP67, floats, and gives even sound all around the pool, but its battery is shorter at about 15 hours. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers)
- **Best budget: Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4.** It's IP67, floats, and lasts about 14 hours. BestProducts listed it at $65. [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)
- **Most portable: JBL Grip.** Good Housekeeping's best overall for the beach. It's IP68 and sized like a drink can, at about $100. The mesh can trap dust. [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)
- **Cheapest: JBL Go 5.** It's soap-bar sized, IP67, and about $40, but battery is only 8 hours. [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)
- **Big party speaker: Soundcore Boom 2 Plus.** It's IPX7, floats, and puts out 100 W with up to 20 hours of battery. It's heavy at 3.8 kg and lists no dust rating, so keep it on a towel at the beach. The list price is $249.99, and Dealectric reports that code AFSC20 took it to $200 when tested on 2026-10-22. The checkout price is what counts. [Buy at Soundcore](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus) (an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you)

## Care tips

IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine damage. RTINGS suggests at least rinsing the speaker with fresh water after use. Keep the charging port closed, and dry the speaker fully before charging.

If you tell me your budget and whether you want something pocketable or party-loud, I can narrow it to one.
